title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-06-19 02:25:50 最新章节：第 144 章 雁门关大捷龙国震动
lines: 蔚蓝星球，武道昌盛，仙道存续，超凡文明绵延数万年。
历经上古浩劫、仙道断层、武道更迭，整片蓝星最终沉淀出五大顶级霸主帝国。
五国割据五洲大陆，鼎立天下，主宰着这颗星球所有的灵脉资源、修行秩序与文明走向。
世人歌颂千载和平，以为五国制衡、互不侵犯，盛世永续、山河无战。
可只有站在各国权力最顶端的执掌者才清楚，这看似稳固的百年制衡，不过是一层薄如蝉翼的虚假和平。
天地本源灵脉逐年枯竭，凡间修行资源日益匮乏，高阶修炼体系彻底触顶瓶颈。
五大强国疆域固化，再无向外拓土的空间。
想要突破种族上限、延续文明巅峰、孕育更强的超凡战力，唯一的出路，便是弱肉强食、吞国夺运。
古老的丛林法则撕破虚伪的文明外衣，冰冷的灭国棋局，早已在暗中悄然铺开。
整片蓝星，如今由五大超级帝国分治。
每一国都拥有独属于自己的顶级修行体系，壁垒森严、各有强弱，彼此制衡千年，恩怨纠葛无数。
第一国，龙国。
龙国坐拥整片东洲最广袤的沃土、最浑厚的天地灵脉，传承万古武道与正统仙道文明，底蕴冠绝蓝星。
龙国人道气运绵长厚重，子民坚韧不屈，武道根基扎根万古，诞生无数镇世战神、仙道大能。
其修行体系为武道、仙道双修，攻守兼备、成长性无敌，人道加持之下，后期潜力冠绝五国。
但龙国守成之心过重，千年以来不喜征伐、待人赤诚、怀柔治世，对外毫无防备之心。
且纯武道体系虽单体无敌，却极度惧怕阵法禁锢、心神扰乱、持续耗杀，体系短板明显。
第二国，黑日国。
黑日国盘踞北境极寒海域，岛国疆域狭小、灵脉贫瘠、资源匮乏。
因此国民天性阴狠隐忍、野心滔天、极度排外。
该国独修星辰星曜+暗影忍术双体系，不重正面硬刚，专研禁法、困阵、暗杀、耗杀。
黑日国隐忍数十年，从不主动挑起正面大战，默默打磨绝杀大阵、培育暗杀死士。
其核心底牌周天星曜大阵，是上古遗留的克制凡间武道的无解闭环阵法。
搭配十二星曜战神战法牧体系、四大天忍暗杀体系，专治正面无敌的肉身武道，阴毒无解、防不胜防，是蛰伏百年的绝世利刃。
第三国，鹰国。
鹰国占据西洲最肥沃的平原疆域，摒弃传统古武与仙道，走极致科技超能体系。
机甲重装、核能军械、基因变异、超能异能四大分支并行，机械化军团规模化作战，火力碾压、续航极强、团战推进无敌。
鹰国崇尚绝对力量与霸权主义，奉行强者至上，四处干涉他国事务，掠夺资源、扶持势力，野心勃勃想要一统蓝星。
其短板同样致命，无道基、无心境、无天道气运加持，所有科技超能手段，在顶级天道法则面前，皆为虚妄。
第四国，欧国。
欧国盘踞南洲神域高地，传承上古奥林匹斯神权体系，执掌神性权柄。
六大主神各掌雷霆、汪洋、光明、战争、狩猎、智慧权能，单体神性爆发极致，高端战力极其恐怖，半神战将数不胜数。
欧国众神高傲自负、孤僻独战、内讧不断，极其缺乏团队配合，军团体系松散，团战漏洞极大。
该国无完善续航与控场体系，单打无敌、团战拉胯，是其千年不变的致命短板。
第五国，佛国。
佛国固守中洲佛域圣土，以万佛金身、业力净化体系立世，防御冠绝五国，续航无解、净化万邪、克制一切阴毒诡术。
content_en:
On the blue planet, martial arts flourish, immortality continues, and extraordinary civilization lasts for tens of thousands of years.
After ancient catastrophes, faults in the immortal way, and changes in martial arts, the entire Blue Star finally settled into five top overlord empires.
The five kingdoms divided the five continents and dominated the world, dominating all the spiritual resources, spiritual order and civilization direction of the planet.
The world praises peace for thousands of years, believing that the five countries have checks and balances and do not invade each other, and the prosperity will last forever and there will be no war in the mountains and rivers.
But only those who stand at the top of power in various countries know that this seemingly stable century-old check and balance is nothing more than a thin layer of false peace.
The original spiritual veins of heaven and earth are drying up year by year, the resources for cultivation in the mortal world are becoming increasingly scarce, and the high-level cultivation system has completely reached its bottleneck.
The territory of the five major powers has been solidified, and there is no room for expansion outside.
If you want to break through the upper limit of race, continue the peak of civilization, and breed stronger extraordinary combat power, the only way out is to eat the weak and devour the country and seize luck.
The ancient laws of the jungle have torn apart the hypocritical cloak of civilization, and the cold chess game of national destruction has long been quietly unfolding in the dark.
The entire Blue Star is now divided and ruled by five super empires.
Each country has its own top-level cultivation system, with strict barriers, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. They have checks and balances on each other for thousands of years, and there are countless grievances and entanglements.
The first country, the dragon country.
The Dragon Kingdom sits on the most extensive fertile soil and the richest spiritual veins of heaven and earth in the entire Eastern Continent. It inherits the eternal martial arts and orthodox immortal civilization, and its heritage is second to none in Blue Star.
The human destiny of the Dragon Kingdom is long and profound, the people are tenacious and unyielding, the foundation of martial arts is rooted in the ages, and countless world-beating war gods and immortal powers have been born.
His practice system is a combination of martial arts and immortality. He is capable of both offense and defense, and has invincible growth potential. With the blessing of humanity, his late-stage potential ranks first among the five countries.
However, the Dragon Kingdom is too focused on maintaining its success. For thousands of years, it has disliked conquests, treated others with sincerity, governed the world with gentleness, and was totally unprepared for foreign affairs.
Moreover, although the pure martial arts system is invincible on its own, it is extremely afraid of the confinement of formations, mental disturbance, and continuous consumption of kills. The shortcomings of the system are obvious.
The second country is the Black Sun Country.
The Black Sun Kingdom is entrenched in the extremely cold waters of the north. The island country has a small territory, barren spiritual veins, and lack of resources.
Therefore, the people's nature is ruthless, tolerant, ambitious, and extremely xenophobic.
The country specializes in the dual system of stars, stars and shadow + shadow ninjutsu. It does not focus on frontal toughness and specializes in forbidden methods, trapping formations, assassinations, and consumption.
The Black Sun Kingdom has been tolerant for decades, never taking the initiative to provoke a direct war, silently polishing the decisive battle formation and cultivating assassins.
Its core trump card, the Zhoutian Xingyao Formation, is an unsolvable closed-loop formation left over from ancient times to restrain mortal martial arts.
Coupled with the Twelve-star Yao War God War Law and Priest System and the Four Heavenly Ninja Assassination System, it specializes in physical martial arts that are invincible from the front. It is insidious and indestructible, and it is a peerless sharp blade that has been dormant for hundreds of years.
The third country, Eagle Country.
The Eagle Kingdom occupies the most fertile plain territory in Western Continent. It abandons traditional ancient martial arts and immortal ways and adopts the ultimate technological super power system.
The four major branches of mecha heavy equipment, nuclear ordnance, genetic mutation, and superpowers work in parallel. The mechanized legion fights on a large scale, with crushing firepower, extremely strong battery life, and invincible team battle advancement.
The Eagle Nation advocates absolute power and hegemony, pursues the supremacy of the strong, interferes in the affairs of other countries, plunders resources, supports forces, and is ambitious to unify Blue Star.
Its shortcomings are equally fatal. It has no Dao foundation, no state of mind, and no blessing of heavenly destiny. All technological and super-powerful means are all vain in the face of the top laws of heaven.
The fourth country is Europe.
Europe occupies the divine highlands of Southern Europe, inherits the ancient Olympus theocratic system, and controls divine authority.
Each of the six main gods controls the power of thunder, ocean, light, war, hunting, and wisdom. The individual divinity explodes to the extreme, the high-end combat power is extremely terrifying, and there are countless demigod warriors.
The European gods are arrogant, lonely, fighting alone, and constantly in internal strife. They extremely lack teamwork, have a loose legion system, and have huge loopholes in team battles.
The country does not have a perfect battery life and field control system. It is invincible in singles and suffers from team battles. These are its fatal shortcomings that have not changed for thousands of years.
The fifth country is the Buddhist country.
The Buddhist Kingdom adheres to the holy land of the Buddha Realm in Central China. It is established with the golden body of ten thousand Buddhas and a karma purification system. Its defense is the best among the five countries. It has no solution, purifies all evils, and restrains all insidious tricks.
